reason: The report restricts the sample to the north region (N=656 of 2000) with no design justification, and it claims "no effect" from a non-significant p=0.15 in that underpowered subsample. I re-ran the model on the full sample with the pre-period controls and got about 0.06 (p=0.82). The estimate on the north subsample changes only slightly with added 2020 controls (about 0.31, p=0.47), but the central region shows a different sign (-0.52). Evidence for a null is therefore not established by the chosen sample, and the report should be redone on the full sample, using region fixed effects and the full set of pre-period controls.
